target: cystoliths (in leaf lamina PO_0020039) absent; no PO or FLOPO class for cystolith, so leave unannotated rather than annotate the lamina
fix: '<sub-structure> absent' where the sub-structure word is not a known bearer: drop the statement; never move the absence to the organ named in the section heading
reason: Cystoliths are cell inclusions in the leaf; their absence says nothing about the lamina, which the same taxon describes as puberulous.

target: trichome PO_0000282 absent, inside the fig (fruit PO_0009001 interior); quality PATO_0000462 absent on trichome
fix: '<qualifier> hairs absent' (internal hairs, simple hairs, glandular hairs) = trichome PO_0000282 absent within the section's organ, never the organ absent
reason: Internal hairs of the fig cavity are absent; the fig itself is described (apex convex).

target: gland dots of the leaf (nearest: oil gland PO_0005669) absent on leaf PO_0025034
fix: 'dots absent' / 'epunctate' / 'without pellucid dots' = gland dots (oil gland PO_0005669) absent in the section's organ, not the organ absent
reason: In Myristicaceae, 'dots' are the gland or papilla dots on the lower leaf surface; the leaf itself is described.

target: gland dots of the lamina (nearest: oil gland PO_0005669) absent on leaf lamina PO_0020039
fix: same as X02612: 'dots absent' = gland dots absent, not the lamina absent
reason: Dots absent on the lower surface; the lamina is described as papillose.

target: ray flower PO_0025331 absent (capitulum inflorescence PO_0030121 discoid); flower PO_0009046 present as disk flowers PO_0025332
fix: 'ray florets/flowers absent' = ray flower PO_0025331 absent; the PO synonym 'Asteraceae floret' on flower must not take the absence when a modifier (ray, disc, sterile, female) comes before it
reason: Only the ray florets are missing; the heads are discoid with disc florets.

target: leaf PO_0025034 present but few or reduced (no absence); 'cauline leaves alternate' stands
fix: 'nearly/almost/subleafless', 'nearly absent', 'scarcely present' = reduced or few, never PATO_0000462 absent; a hedging adverb before an absence word cancels the absence
reason: 'Nearly leafless' means few or reduced leaves; leaves are then described.

target: lower (basal) leaf sheaths PO_0020104 without lamina vs upper leaves with light-green blades
fix: 'bladeless sheaths' / 'the lower bladeless' / 'basal sheaths bladeless' = leaf lamina absent only on the named lower or basal sheaths (keep the position words as context); never 'leaf lamina absent' for the whole taxon
reason: In Carex the lowest sheaths lack blades while the upper leaves have them.

target: 'very stout' belongs to the scape or inflorescence axis (peduncle), not the vegetative stem; 'stemless' = acaulescent vegetative shoot (stem PO_0009047 absent above ground)
fix: PO puts 'scape' under stem PO_0009047; in an acaulescent plant a description of the scape or inflorescence stalk must go to the peduncle or inflorescence axis, not to stem
reason: Stemless rosette bromeliads still have a scape, which is usually what is called stout.

target: no annotation: the fruit is unknown, not absent; 'lateral lobes broadly deltoid' is probably perianth (calyx) lobes PO_0009058, not fruit
fix: 'X not seen / not known / unknown / not observed / not available' = missing data, never PATO_0000462 absent
reason: 'Capsules not seen' reports missing specimens; it does not say the plant lacks fruit.

target: domatium FLOPO_0986021 absent on leaf lamina PO_0020039
fix: 'domatia absent' = domatium FLOPO_0986021 absent; an absent sub-structure must not fall back to its host organ
reason: The domatia are absent; the lamina is described as glabrous.

target: glumes muticous (awn absent on glume) vs lemma awn straight or curved
fix: 'muticous'/'awnless' takes as bearer the organ it qualifies (glume, lemma, palea) and means awn PO_0025349 absent on that organ only; with grasses, keep the qualified organ as context
reason: In Alopecurus the glumes are muticous while the lemma bears an awn.

target: lower (sterile) floret: palea absent or vestigial vs upper (fertile) floret: palea apex acuminate
fix: 'without (significant) palea' in a grass spikelet = palea PO_0009038 absent or reduced in the lower or sterile floret; keep the floret (lower/upper, sterile/fertile) as context
reason: In Panicoideae the lower floret often lacks a palea while the upper floret has one.

target: trichome PO_0000282 absent on leaf PO_0025034 (= leaf glabrous PATO_0000453)
fix: 'Hairs: absent' in a part's section = trichome PO_0000282 absent (or the part glabrous PATO_0000453), never the part absent
reason: The hairs are absent, not the leaf, which is described as V-shaped.

target: the perianth tube's annulus (a ring inside the tube) absent; no class, so leave unannotated. The 'broad and shallow' limb belongs to perianth PO_0009058, not corolla
fix: 'annulus absent' (or any word in config/flora_rejected_bearer_words.tsv) = drop the statement; never move the absence to the organ in the heading. In Aristolochia, 'perianth/calyx' must not be mapped to corolla
reason: The annulus is a ring inside the perianth tube; its absence does not make the perianth or corolla absent.

target: basal sheaths PO_0020104 bladeless vs blades of the upper leaves narrowly triangular-channelled
fix: same as X02616: 'bladeless' with a sheath or position word scopes the lamina absence to those sheaths
reason: Carex lasiocarpa has bladeless basal sheaths and well-formed blades higher up.

target: caudex (perennial woody stem base; nearest stem base PO_0008039) absent; flowering stems present and glabrous
fix: 'caudex absent' / 'without a caudex' = the plant has no perennial woody stem base (often annual); because PO lists 'caudex' as a synonym of stem PO_0009047, this word must not take the absence to stem
reason: Eriogonum descriptions say 'caudex absent' for annuals; the stems are described.

target: colleter FLOPO_0986023 absent on leaf lamina PO_0020039
fix: 'laminar/petiolar colleters absent' = colleter FLOPO_0986023 absent on the named organ; the adjective gives the location, not the absent part
reason: The colleters are absent; the lamina is described as coriaceous.

target: cauline leaf PO_0000013 absent; leaf PO_0025034 present as basal leaves
fix: 'cauline/stem/basal/axillary leaves absent' = the subtype absent (cauline leaf PO_0000013, etc.), never leaf PO_0025034 absent
reason: Only the cauline leaves are missing; Lewisia stebbinsii has basal leaves.

target: axillary leaf clusters (secondary leaves in the axils) absent; no exact PO class, so leave unannotated; leaf PO_0025034 present
fix: 'axillary leaves/fascicles absent' = absence of the axillary leaf clusters only; the modifier must stop the absence reaching leaf PO_0025034
reason: FNA Caryophyllaceae note whether axillary leaf clusters are present; the main leaves are described.

target: phyllode leaf PO_0025335 absent; the pitcher leaves PO_0025034 are present
fix: 'phyllodia absent' = phyllode leaf PO_0025335 absent; a synonym of a leaf subtype must map to that subtype, not to leaf
reason: Sarracenia psittacina lacks flat phyllodes but has pitcher leaves with a recurved hood.

target: marginal (intramarginal) vein, a leaf lamina vein PO_0020138, absent; lamina base cuneate
fix: 'marginal/intramarginal/collective vein absent' = that vein (leaf lamina vein PO_0020138) absent, not the lamina absent
reason: Ardisia descriptions note whether a marginal vein is present; the lamina is described.

target: peduncle/scape without sterile bracts vs floral bracts PO_0009055 present and deciduous at anthesis
fix: 'ebracteate' after peduncle/scape/rachis = sterile bracts absent on that axis only; floral bracts are a separate member and keep their own statements
reason: In orchids, 'ebracteate' usually refers to the peduncle, while floral bracts are described separately.

target: basal bladeless sheaths PO_0020104 vs flat blades of the leaves
fix: same as X02616: 'bladeless sheaths' scopes the lamina absence to those sheaths
reason: This is the pattern named in docs/km-classification.md: the basal sheaths lack blades while the leaves have flat blades.

target: flowering stem leafless or with reduced bractlike cauline leaves PO_0000013 vs leaves (basal or cauline) triangular to bractlike
fix: 'leafless' in a stem or scape section = cauline leaves absent or reduced on that stem (cauline leaf PO_0000013), not leaf PO_0025034 absent for the taxon; an 'or with bractlike leaves' alternative cancels a hard absence
reason: The same taxon describes triangular to bractlike leaves, so 'leafless' must refer to the stems or to reduced leaves.

target: leaf sheath auricle PO_0020106 absent and oral setae (trichome PO_0000282 at the sheath mouth) absent; 'leathery' belongs to the culm or leaf sheath, not stipule
fix: In grasses/bamboos 'auricles' = leaf sheath auricle PO_0020106 (never stipule PO_0020041) and 'oral setae' = trichome; their absence must not reach the sheath or any stipule
reason: Bamboos have no stipules; the auricles and setae are absent, and the sheath is leathery.

target: leaf sheath auricle PO_0020106 absent; 'yellow-brown' belongs to the culm sheath, not stipule
fix: same as X02634: 'auricles absent' = leaf sheath auricle PO_0020106 absent, never stipule
reason: Auricles are missing; the sheath is described as yellow-brown. 'Stipule' is the wrong bearer in both statements.

target: no annotation (flowers unknown, not absent); the present statement belongs to infructescence PO_0006342, not inflorescence
fix: 'Flowers not known/not seen/unknown' = missing data, never an absence; an 'Infructescences:' heading maps to infructescence, not inflorescence
reason: The flowers were not collected; the plant does flower, since it fruits.

target: frond stalk absent (nearest petiole PO_0020038 absent on the frond); the frond (leaf PO_0025034 via the synonym 'frond') is present
fix: 'without a (green) stalk at base' = stalk (petiole or stipe) absent on the organ, not the organ absent; 'without <part> at/on <organ>' always takes the part as the absent bearer
reason: Lemna minor fronds lack a stalk; the frond is described by its length-to-width ratio.

target: no annotation (flowers unknown, not absent); cyme inflorescence PO_0030126 present stands
fix: same as X02636: 'not seen/not known' = missing data, never PATO_0000462 absent
reason: The flowers were not seen on the specimens; a cymose inflorescence is described.

target: peduncle without sterile bracts vs floral bracts PO_0009055 with acuminate apex
fix: same as X02631: '<axis> ebracteate' = bracts absent on that axis only, kept as context; floral bracts are a separate member
reason: The flora says 'Peduncle ebracteate'; the acuminate bracts are the floral bracts.
